discovery.summary: Check a Pennsylvania vendor registered-address distance
discovery.description: Resolve a Pennsylvania vendor to one strong registry entity, geocode the caller's origin address and the source-published registry address using U.S. Census Geocoding Services, and compare straight-line great-circle distance with maxDistanceMiles. Returns within_radius, outside_radius, company_not_found, or human_review. Distance is not driving distance or travel time, and the result does not prove local ownership, service area, residency, physical control, tax situs, good standing, authority, or legal compliance.
discovery.resource_description: Resolve a Pennsylvania vendor registry entity, geocode a caller-supplied origin address and the source-published registered address with the U.S. Census geocoder, and compare straight-line coordinate distance with a caller-selected radius. Returns within_radius, outside_radius, company_not_found, or human_review. It is a geographic policy signal, not driving distance, travel time, local ownership, service area, residency, tax situs, good standing, authority, or legal/compliance approval.

buyer.task: Resolve a Pennsylvania business to one strong registry entity, geocode a caller-supplied origin address and the source-published registry address, and compare straight-line Census-coordinate distance with a caller-supplied radius.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independent, verified external settled purchases and repeat demand; do not count test fixtures, discovery probes, or HTTP 200 responses as sales.

example_query.originAddress: 600 North Second Street, Suite 401, Harrisburg, PA 17101

sources.authority: Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
sources.refresh_policy: live lookup on each paid request
live comparison on each paid request after strong registry match

parameters.measure: straight-line great-circle Census-coordinate miles; never driving mileage

rules: Require unique strong PA registry entity and source-published registered address.
Geocode both caller origin and registry address using U.S. Census Geocoding Services; unavailable or uncertain evidence requires human_review.
Evaluate straight-line coordinate distance versus caller maxDistanceMiles; not a driving distance or geographic eligibility certification.
distance is straight-line great-circle distance between Census geocoder coordinates, not driving distance or travel time
the registry address is source-published public registration data and does not prove current operations or physical control
within_radius is only a caller-defined geographic policy result and does not prove local ownership, service area, residency, tax situs, good standing, authority, or legal compliance

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502, chargeable=false; do not settle payment.

criteria: Run existing product release gate and deterministic source-contract tests at the same candidate revision.
Independently reverify provider sources and seller-specific payment/hosting costs before approval to release.
Commercial promotion requires externally verified buyers, full unit economics and human security/integration review.
